pages.text: Mom dived in the stream. Headfirst, one flick of her tail, and under she went.
Mom came up with a shiny pebble in her beak. "I want to bring back a pebble too!" said Mumu.
Dodo stepped forward. "I know diving! Watch!"
Dodo plunged headfirst. Huh? Only her bottom floated above the water.
Phew! She came up with water plants hanging from her head.
"The underwater kingdom... gave me a hat." Wearing the plants, Dodo grinned.
Mumu watched Mom again. One tail flick, then she slipped smoothly under.
Mumu flicked his tail once too. Under he went, leaving only round ripples.
Phew! Mumu came up with a shiny pebble in his beak.
Dodo clapped her wings. "That's my little brother! And I'm the queen of the water kingdom!" Her plant crown slipped down, and everyone laughed.
